clippings.speaker: Emmanuel Lubezki
clippings.quote: Terry came to me and he said, “Chivo, please don’t read the script.” The script was very, very long. … He wanted me to document this as if it was somebody’s memory. That’s it, we never talked about anything else.
clippings.title: Emmanuel Lubezki on ‘The Revenant’ and ‘Knight of Cups’
clippings.context: Interview after his third straight Oscar, on shooting Knight of Cups without reading the script.

clippings.speaker: Emmanuel Lubezki
clippings.quote: The only way I have to know if we’re getting the scene or not, I’d turn sometimes to Terry and see if I could get a feeling from his expression.
clippings.title: Emmanuel Lubezki on ‘The Revenant’ and ‘Knight of Cups’
clippings.context: On the fun and fear of shooting scenes without knowing the script.

clippings.speaker: Emmanuel Lubezki
clippings.quote: That only tells me how incredible Terry is, because he’s so daring. This is a crazy experiment in a way – not crazy, I wouldn’t say crazy. It’s a wonderful experiment.
clippings.title: Emmanuel Lubezki on ‘The Revenant’ and ‘Knight of Cups’
clippings.context: Responding to the idea that Knight of Cups feels like the work of a much younger filmmaker.

clippings.speaker: Emmanuel Lubezki
clippings.quote: I think some of the Terry DNA must have come out because I’m his pupil, he’s my teacher.
clippings.title: Emmanuel Lubezki on ‘The Revenant’ and ‘Knight of Cups’
clippings.context: On how working with Malick prepared him for shooting Iñárritu's The Revenant.

clippings.speaker: Emmanuel Lubezki
clippings.quote: Working with Terry, sometimes I can shoot a whole day and not know if there’s anything that’s going to be usable. … That can sometimes be frustrating but ultimately it’s rewarding because it allows for the special or spontaneous moment, and Terry also encourages me to take risks.
clippings.title: Contender: Director of Photography Emmanuel Lubezki, The Tree of Life
clippings.context: Awards-season trade profile on shooting The Tree of Life; the two joke that each day is a fishing trip.

clippings.speaker: Emmanuel Lubezki
clippings.quote: You learn so much by watching an artist like Terry at work. … For me, he has been an extraordinary film teacher and much more.
clippings.title: Cosmic Questions
clippings.context: From American Cinematographer's August 2011 Tree of Life cover story, excerpted with credit by Cinephilia & Beyond (the ASC page itself was blocked).

notes: Malick gives almost no interviews; no verifiable quote of him on Lubezki found (SXSW 2017 panel reports and the 2007 Rome conversation don't mention him), so only one direction. IndieWire (tollbit), British Cinematographer (Cloudflare) and theasc.com were blocked; The Other Journal and Collider only re-quote IndieWire/LA Times.
